meta.name: solidity-security
meta.description: Master smart contract security best practices to prevent common vulnerabilities and implement secure Solidity patterns. Use when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or implementing security measures for blockchain applications.

copy.tagline_en: Write smart contracts that resist common security exploits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing or auditing blockchain contracts and worry about vulnerabilities

howto.what: 写 Solidity 合约时，Claude 会按安全模式产出代码，处理重入、溢出、权限控制等问题，并写 Hardhat 安全测试、补审计注释。
howto.when: 当你编写智能合约、审计已有合约，或为区块链应用实现安全措施时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个合约有没有重入漏洞
say.note: 会逐项排查并给出修法

say.text: 用 Hardhat 写一个防重入攻击的测试
say.note: 生成可运行的测试代码

say.text: 给这个合约补上审计用的注释
say.note: 按审计要求补文档注释

howto.what_en: When writing Solidity contracts, Claude follows secure patterns against reentrancy, overflow and access control issues, writes Hardhat security tests, and adds audit-ready doc comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write smart contracts, audit existing contracts for vulnerabilities, or implement security measures for blockchain apps.

say_en.text: Check this contract for reentrancy vulnerabilities
say_en.note: It reviews the code and suggests fixes

say_en.text: Write a Hardhat test that blocks a reentrancy attack
Add audit-ready comments to this contract
say_en.note: It adds documentation comments for auditors
